Type: bracketed floating wall shelf
Use: displaying books, plants and decor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, glam, contemporary
Materials: wood plank shelf, gold-finished metal brackets
Colors: warm medium brown wood, gold
Shape: long narrow plank on two curved scroll brackets with tapered points, slim and linear, light visual weight
Feel: warm, refined, polished
Goes with: brass accents, white or deep-toned walls, walnut or oak wood; modern, glam or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Curved Frame Floating Wall Shelf, 25"W, Gold and Natural Wood
product.description: This modern shelving unit is a great way to add an extra dimension to your wall decorations. The solid-fir shelf sits atop a gold-colored iron frame and 4 golden arches, which strengthen the shelf visually and structurally. 7.48"H x 25"W x 6.5"D 90% fir; 10% iron Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
